scope: Selected historical RAF CNN3 checkpoints only; no forward/model-class construction/data evaluation/Test/remote
zero_L1_policy: ratio null; count separately, never divide by zero
large_gain_threshold: No chosen large-gain cutoff or threshold search; continuous distributions only
boundary_statistics: Also report prefix sums of first1/first2 taps because unavailable previous observations are masked to zero. Three-tap DC statement applies only with all3 observations available.
mathematical_interpretation: For a channel constant over observed projected history x, residual=sum(kernel)*x and output=(1+sum(kernel))*x when all3 taps exist. A nonzero sum is not evidence of raw-quantity bias; projected QKV mix time, quantity and other encoder signals. Constant quantity does not imply constant QKV projection.
scientific_scope: Parameter inspection only; cannot determine activation-weighted effect, error causality, or benefit of a future zero-sum constraint.
